name: Inspector Sommers in: Ouroborian Madness
storyline:
You are the world's best private investigator, hired to solve the murder of a world-renowned scientist. Enter his mansion and abandon all semblance of space and time as you know them. Are you ready to solve this mystery?

How do you escape a place that won't let you go?

Inspector Sommers presents a very interesting idea: how do you escape a room where the space itself distorts to prevent you from leaving? In this daring game, you must use a unique mechanic to navigate an environment where a crime has been committed.

The game's main feature is that if you try to leave the room through one door, you reappear in the same room through the adjacent door. Furthermore, you can find different clocks that will allow you to visit the same space at different times. Gather clues and information about the case by uncovering all the secrets and lies hidden within the mansion's walls.

A cinematic package brimming with detail

This adventure blends elements of classic video game sagas with the aesthetic and narrative aspects of film and mystery novels. This is driven by a story set on the outskirts of London at the end of the Cold War, presenting a murder case where you'll face situations unlike anything you've ever encountered.
summary: Inspector Sommers in: Ouroborian Madness: The escape room that breaks the laws of physics and time. Investigation, time travel, and a warping mansion await in this Cold War-era mystery adventure.
